summary: Frontend-only testing of Bilbao Pintxo Passport SPA. All 9 requested test scenarios verified successfully: hero + progress bar, Leaflet map with 10 numbered pins, 10 stop cards with stamp/maps buttons, sealing toggles progress and shows BILBAO badge, filters (all/pending/visited) work correctly (1/9/10 after 1 seal), localStorage persistence works across reload, Maps links point to google.com/maps with target=_blank, all 6 character cards render with images, and all 18 /ill/*.png images return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is likely large (single-file SPA with stops+characters arrays inline). If it grows beyond ~700 lines consider extracting stops/characters data into /app/src/data/*.ts and card components into /app/src/components/*.tsx for maintainability.
RouteMap loads Leaflet CSS/JS from unpkg CDN at runtime - works but adds external dependency risk; consider bundling react-leaflet or leaflet via npm for reliability.

Hero title 'PASAPORTE DE PINTXOS' is split into separate spans across lines - test agents using text="PASAPORTE DE PINTXOS" locators will miss it. Consider adding a data-testid="hero-title" on the container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 checklist items pass. Progress starts 0/10 0%. Sealing stop 1 -> 1/10 10%, badge appears, button text 'Sellado'. Filter visited=1, pending=9, all=10. Persistence via localStorage 'bilbao-passport-stamps' works. Map renders 10 leaflet-marker-icon pins after ~3-4s CDN load. All /ill/*.png assets return HTTP 200. Character keys: marijaia, leon, gigantes, txikiteros, arrantzales, begona (note: img files use singular txikitero/arrantzale). No console errors observed.
